gaps.explanation: Statement p4 (Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Cash Basis - Governmental Funds) prints five fund columns; detail has only the General, Street and Lottery budgetary schedules (pp8-10), whose actuals equal those columns. The Debt Service Fund and Community Development Fund columns have no schedule. Debt Service Fund: Property taxes 932,959 + Intergovernmental 85,026 + Investment income (loss) 289 = 1,018,274; Community Development Fund: Investment income (loss) (734,840) + Miscellaneous 10,000 = (724,840). Added = 293,434. Check: 9,859,501 + 293,434 = 10,152,935 = statement Total revenues.
